questions.question: Who is the author of the book Operation Sindoor: The Untold Story of India’s Deep Strikes Inside Pakistan?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Lt. Gen. KJS Dhillion.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Chief of Army Staff General Upendra Dwivedi launched the book *Operation Sindoor: The Untold Story of India’s Deep Strikes Inside Pakistan* written by Retd. Lt. Gen. KJS Dhillion in New Delhi.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **The book was authored by Retd. Lt. Gen. KJS Dhillion.**
 
• **The book narrates the story of India’s deep strikes inside Pakistan during Operation Sindoor.**
 
• **General Upendra Dwivedi praised the book as a tribute to the Indian Army's courage and professionalism.**
 
• **The book is recommended for academia and research scholars as a reference material.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• General Upendra Dwivedi__ - The Chief of the Army Staff of India, who launched the book.
 
• __Lt. Gen. KJS Dhillion__ - A retired Lieutenant General of the Indian Army and the author of the book.
 
• __Operation Sindoor__ - A military operation by the Indian Army involving deep strikes inside Pakistan.

questions.question: Where was the 14th edition of Exercise MAITREE, a bilateral military exercise between India and Thailand, held?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Joint Training Node (JTN), Umroi, Meghalaya.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **The 14th edition of Exercise MAITREE is being held at the Joint Training Node (JTN) in Umroi, Meghalaya, from 1st to 14th September 2025.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Exercise MAITREE has been a key bilateral initiative since 2006, aiming to enhance mutual understanding and joint tactical capabilities between India and Thailand.**
 
• This bilateral military exercise, involving India and Thailand, focuses on enhancing operational interoperability and strategic cooperation between the two nations.
 
• The exercise this year focuses on company-level counter-terrorist operations in semi-urban terrain under the framework of the United Nations Charter.
 
• The Indian Army is represented by a battalion from the Madras Regiment, while Thailand’s Royal Army has deployed personnel from its 1st Infantry Battalion.
 
• The exercise takes place as part of a rotational format, with the previous edition held in Thailand, continuing the annual collaboration between the two countries.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Exercise MAITREE:__ A long-standing bilateral military exercise initiated in 2006 to strengthen defense cooperation between India and Thailand.
 
• __UN Chapter VII:__ Refers to actions to maintain or restore international peace and security, under which this year's focus is on counter-terrorism operations.
 
• __Rotational Format:__ The exercise alternates between India and Thailand annually, showcasing the countries' continued military engagement and commitment to regional security.

questions.question: According to the National Institutional Ranking Framework (NIRF) Rankings 2025, which institution secured the top position overall for the seventh consecutive year?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Indian Institute of Technology (IIT), Madras.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **The Ministry of Education released the NIRF Rankings 2025, the 10th edition of India’s higher education rankings.**
 
• **IIT Madras bagged the top spot overall for the seventh year in a row.**
 
• **The rankings were announced by Union Education Minister Dharmendra Pradhan at Bharat Mandapam, New Delhi.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **IIT Madras retained its top position overall in NIRF 2025.**
 
• **The Indian Institute of Science (IISc), Bengaluru, was ranked the best university in India.**
 
• **IIM Ahmedabad topped the Management category as the best B-school.**
 
• **IIT Roorkee secured the top position in the Architecture and Planning category.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Categories in NIRF 2025**__

 __
 
• Total: 17 categories including Overall, Universities, Colleges, Engineering, Management, Law, Medical, Dental, Pharmacy, Agriculture, Innovation, Open University, Skill University, State Public University, and SDG/Sustainability.
 
 
 
• **Methodology**__
 __
 
• Based on parameters like Teaching, Learning & Resources, Research & Professional Practice, Graduation Outcomes, Outreach & Inclusivity, and Perception.
 
 
 
• **Other Highlights**__
 __
 
• Jadavpur University, Kolkata, topped among State Public Universities.
 
• IISc Bengaluru retained its position as the top-ranked University overall.
 
 
 
• **Significance**__
 
 
• NIRF, launched in 2015, has become the official framework to assess and rank India’s higher education institutions.

questions.question: Which Indian city will host the 5th Coast Guard Global Summit (CGGS) in 2027?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Chennai.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **India will host the 5th Coast Guard Global Summit (CGGS) in Chennai in 2027.**
 
• **The event will coincide with the Golden Jubilee celebrations of the Indian Coast Guard (ICG).**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Chennai will host the 5th Coast Guard Global Summit (CGGS) in 2027, aligning with the Golden Jubilee of the Indian Coast Guard.**
 
• The summit will feature an International Coast Guard Fleet Review and a World Coast Guard Seminar, focusing on emerging maritime challenges.
 
• The decision to host the summit in Chennai was made unanimously during the 4th CGGS held in Rome in September 2025.
 
• The summit will provide a global platform for fostering cooperation and addressing shared maritime challenges among Coast Guards worldwide.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Indian Coast Guard (ICG)__

 __
 
• A multi-mission organization tasked with maritime security, environmental protection, and search and rescue operations in Indian waters.
 
 
 
• Maritime Search and Rescue (M-SAR)__
 __
 
• International efforts for coordinated search and rescue operations in maritime regions, highlighted during the India–Italy discussions.
 
 
 
• CGGS (Coast Guard Global Summit)__
 
 
• An international summit for global Coast Guard cooperation, addressing maritime security, environmental protection, and transnational maritime crimes.

questions.question: What is the name of the pilot project launched by the Delhi government to provide rest facilities for patient attendants at city hospitals?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Vishram Grih.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **The Delhi government will launch the ‘Vishram Grih’ pilot project for patient attendants at city hospitals in the coming months.**
 
• **The project will offer rest facilities at hospitals such as Lok Nayak Hospital, Ambedkar Hospital, and Deen Dayal Upadhyay Hospital.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Vishram Grih will be available at a nominal charge of Rs 5 for one or two family members of patients.**
 
• **The facilities will include clean restrooms, proper bedding, and food arrangements.**
 
• **The pilot project will begin at four to five hospitals, starting with Lok Nayak, Ambedkar, and Deen Dayal Upadhyay hospitals.**
 
• **The initiative aims to provide a safe and comfortable space for hospital attendants, preventing them from sleeping on the streets.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **About Vishram Grih**__

 __
 
• The pilot project is designed to offer basic facilities to the attendants of hospitalized patients.
 
• The goal is to provide them with a safe resting space, reducing the burden of unsafe sleeping areas around hospitals.
 
 
 
• **Phases of Implementation**__
 
 
• The first phase will focus on providing the basic facilities at select hospitals, with the possibility of expanding later.

questions.question: What does the acronym BHARATI stand for in the new initiative launched by APEDA?

options.text: Bharat’s Hub for Agritech, Resilience, Advancement and Incubation for Export Enablement
Bharat’s Hub for Agricultural Research and Technology Innovation
Bharat’s Hub for Agricultural Resilience and Trade Integration
Bharat’s Hub for Agribusiness, Resources, and Technological Innovation

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Bharat’s Hub for Agritech, Resilience, Advancement and Incubation for Export Enablement.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **APEDA launched BHARATI, a new initiative to support India’s agri-food startups and boost exports.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **BHARATI stands for Bharat’s Hub for Agritech, Resilience, Advancement and Incubation for Export Enablement.**
 
• The initiative aims to promote innovation and accelerate India’s agri-food exports to 50 billion dollars by 2030.
 
• The initiative is aligned with India’s Atmanirbhar Bharat and Startup India vision.
 
• BHARATI aims to support 100 agri-food startups and foster innovation to strengthen India’s position in global agri-food trade.
 
• It is designed to help achieve the goal of increasing India’s agri-food exports to 50 billion dollars by 2030.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• APEDA:__ The Agricultural and Processed Food Products Export Development Authority, which aims to promote India's agri-food exports.
 
• __Atmanirbhar Bharat:__ An initiative aimed at making India self-reliant in various sectors, including agriculture.
 
• __Startup India:__ A government initiative to support and promote innovation and startups in India.

questions.question: Who won the 2025 US Open Men's Singles title, defeating Jannik Sinner in the final?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Carlos Alcaraz.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Carlos Alcaraz won the 2025 US Open Men’s Singles title, defeating Jannik Sinner in the final.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Carlos Alcaraz won his second US Open and sixth Grand Slam title, reaffirming his dominance in the sport.**
 
• **Alcaraz became the youngest man since Björn Borg to win six Grand Slam titles.**
 
• **The win also marked Alcaraz’s second US Open victory, continuing his impressive career at a young age.**
 
• **The final against Jannik Sinner was one of the exciting matches that showcased Alcaraz's skill and composure under pressure.**
 
• Aryna Sabalenka of Belarus successfully defended her Women's Singles title at the 2025 US Open, defeating Amanda Anisimova from the USA in the final.
 
• Sabalenka became the first woman since Serena Williams in 2014 to win back-to-back US Open titles.
 
• In doubles, Marcel Granollers and Horacio Zeballos won Men’s Doubles, while Gabriela Dabrowski and Erin Routliffe clinched the Women’s Doubles title.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Carlos Alcaraz__

 __
 
• Alcaraz, from Spain, is one of the rising stars of tennis, known for his powerful groundstrokes and athleticism on the court.
 
 
 
• Jannik Sinner__
 
 
• Jannik Sinner, from Italy, is another young player showing tremendous promise in the tennis world, known for his versatility and powerful game.

questions.question: Which state’s Chief Minister announced cashless medical treatment for all state teachers on Teachers' Day in 2025?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Uttar Pradesh.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Uttar Pradesh Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath announced cashless medical treatment for all state teachers, including primary, upper-primary, secondary teachers, Shiksha Mitras, instructors, and cooks.**
 
• **This initiative will cover approximately nine lakh teachers and their families.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **CM Yogi described this as a symbol of gratitude towards teachers for their contributions.**
 
• **Teachers and their families will no longer face financial difficulties due to illness or emergencies.**
 
• **On Teachers’ Day, CM Yogi also honoured teachers, distributed tablets, and inaugurated smart classrooms.**
 
• **CM emphasized that teachers must continue to perform their best for the education of children, with full government support.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **About the Cashless Medical Treatment Initiative**__

 __
 
• Facility includes teachers in primary, secondary, and aided schools, along with Shiksha Mitras, instructors, and cooks.
 
• Designed to ease financial burdens on teachers and their families during health emergencies.
 
 
 
• **Teachers’ Day Event in Lucknow**__
 __
 
• CM Yogi honoured teachers and distributed tablets to enhance digital learning.
 
• Smart classrooms were inaugurated to further support modern education.
 
 
 
• **Government Support for Teachers**__
 
 
• CM assured continued full government support for teachers’ professional growth and well-being.

questions.question: What significant event is marked on 11th September in India as "Digvijay Diwas"?

options.text: The signing of the Indian Independence Act
Swami Vivekananda’s speech at the World’s Parliament of Religions
The birth anniversary of Jawaharlal Nehru
The foundation day of the Indian Constitution

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Swami Vivekananda’s speech at the World’s Parliament of Religions**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **India observes Digvijay Diwas on 11th September to honor Swami Vivekananda’s landmark speech at the First Parliament of the World’s Religions in Chicago on this day in 1893.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Swami Vivekananda’s speech at the Parliament of Religions in Chicago began with the iconic words, “Sisters and Brothers of America,” which earned him a standing ovation and global recognition.**
 
• He emphasized the universality of religion, called for interfaith understanding, and condemned sectarianism and fanaticism, promoting global harmony.
 
• Vivekananda recited from the Bhagavad Gita, advocating that holiness, purity, and charity transcend all religious boundaries.
 
• The speech played a significant role in India’s spiritual renaissance and continues to inspire youth empowerment and global unity.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Swami Vivekananda__

 __
 
• A prominent spiritual leader who represented India at the 1893 Parliament of Religions in Chicago, advocating for religious tolerance and global unity.
 
 
 
• The Parliament of Religions (1893)__
 __
 
• A historic event in Chicago where religious leaders from around the world gathered, with Swami Vivekananda delivering a powerful speech on religious unity and harmony.
 
 
 
• Digvijay Diwas__
 
 
• An observance in India to commemorate Swami Vivekananda’s impactful speech, which highlighted India’s rich philosophical heritage and spiritual identity.
